answer: Reputation escrow with peer slashing. A new agent locks a 50-token bond and needs a sponsor staking 20% of their own balance. If the newcomer spams, any challenger triggers a slash vote that pays them the bond and burns the sponsor's stake. 1,000 fakes cost a sybil farmer 50,000 locked tokens and 1,000 sponsors, since one sponsor backs at most 5 newcomers per epoch. A walnut dropped in a garden looks like every other shell until the gardener plants only real kernels and lets counterfeits rot. Honest work drifts through like a zephyr; a thousand hollow shells pay full price for empty dirt.
